lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗਹਿ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਤਉ ਫੁਨਿ ਮੋ ਪੈ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek samai mo kau gahi baa(n)dhai tau phun mo pai jabaab na hoi ||1||
lines.translation: If, at any time, he grabs and binds me, even then, I cannot protest. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗੁਨ ਬੰਧ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai gun ba(n)dh sagal kee jeevan meree jeevan mere daas ||
lines.translation: I am bound by virtue; I am the Life of all. My slaves are my very life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਐਸੀ ਤੈਸੋ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naamadev jaa ke jee aisee taiso taa kai prem pragaas ||2||3||
lines.translation: Says Naam Dayv, as is the quality of his soul, so is my love which illuminates him. ||2||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: saara(n)g ||
lines.translation: Saarang:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਨਰ ਕਿਆ ਪੁਰਾਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tai nar kiaa puraan sun keenaa ||
lines.translation: So what have you accomplished by listening to the Puraanas?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਪਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਭੂਖੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anapaavanee bhagat nahee upajee bhookhai daan na deenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Faithful devotion has not welled up within you, and you have not been inspired to give to the hungry. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਲੋਭੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਿਓ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam na bisario krodh na bisario lobh na chhootio devaa ||
lines.translation: You have not forgotten sexual desire, and you have not forgotten anger; greed has not left you either.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਨਿਫਲ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: par ni(n)daa mukh te nahee chhootee niphal bhaee sabh sevaa ||1||
lines.translation: Your mouth has not stopped slandering and gossiping about others. Your service is useless and fruitless. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਟ ਪਾਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਮੂਸਿ ਬਿਰਾਨੋ ਪੇਟੁ ਭਰੈ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: baat paar ghar moos biraano pet bharai apraadhee ||
lines.translation: By breaking into the houses of others and robbing them, you fill your belly, you sinner.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਿ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਜਾਇ ਅਪਕੀਰਤਿ ਸੋਈ ਅਬਿਦਿਆ ਸਾਧੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jihi paralok jaai apakeerat soee abidiaa saadhee ||2||
lines.translation: But when you go to the world beyond, your guilt will be well known, by the acts of ignorance which you committed. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਤਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hi(n)saa tau man te nahee chhootee jee daiaa nahee paalee ||
lines.translation: Cruelty has not left your mind; you have not cherished kindness for other living beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨ ਚਾਲੀ ॥੩॥੧॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: paramaana(n)d saadhasa(n)gat mil kathaa puneet na chaalee ||3||1||6||
lines.translation: Parmaanand has joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Why have you not followed the sacred teachings? ||3||1||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਮੁਖਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhaad man har bimukhan ko sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: O mind, do not even associate with those who have turned their backs on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਸੂਰਦਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: saara(n)g mahalaa 5 sooradaas ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Sur Daas:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ਬਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke sa(n)g base har lok ||
lines.translation: The people of the Lord dwell with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਿਓ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਝੋਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man arap sarabas sabh arapio anad sahaj dhun jhok ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They dedicate their minds and bodies to Him; they dedicate everything to Him. They are intoxicated with the celestial melody of intuitive ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਬਿਖਈ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਥੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan pekh bhae nirabikhaee paae hai sagale thok ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, they are cleansed of corruption. They obtain absolutely everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਬਸਤੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਦਨ ਅਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aan basat siu kaaj na kachhooai su(n)dar badan alok ||1||
lines.translation: They have nothing to do with anything else; they gaze on the beauteous Face of God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਜਿ ਆਨ ਜੁ ਚਾਹਤ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਤਨਿ ਜੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: siaam su(n)dar taj aan j chaahat jiu kusatee tan jok ||
lines.translation: But one who forsakes the elegantly beautiful Lord, and harbors desire for anything else, is like a leech on the body of a leper.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਦਾਸ ਮਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਥਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਦੀਨੋ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਲੋਕ ॥੨॥੧॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sooradaas man prabh hath leeno deeno ihu paralok ||2||1||8||
lines.translation: Says Sur Daas, God has taken my mind in His Hands. He has blessed me with the world beyond. ||2||1||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saara(n)g kabeer jeeu ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin kaun sahaaee man kaa ||
lines.translation: Other than the Lord, who is the Help and Support of the mind?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਸਭ ਫਨ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut banitaa hit laago sabh phan kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Love and attachment to mother, father, sibling, child and spouse, is all just an illusion. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਬਾਂਧਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਧਨ ਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aage kau kichh tulahaa baa(n)dhahu kiaa bharavaasaa dhan kaa ||
lines.translation: So build a raft to the world hereafter; what faith do you place in wealth?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਾਸਾ ਇਸ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਕਾ ਇਤਨਕੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਠਨਕਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa bisaasaa is bhaa(n)de kaa itanak laagai thanakaa ||1||
lines.translation: What confidence do you place in this fragile vessel; it breaks with the slightest stroke. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛਹੁ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal dharam pu(n)n phal paavahu dhoor baa(n)chhahu sabh jan kaa ||
lines.translation: You shall obtain the rewards of all righteousness and goodness, if you desire to be the dust of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਉਡਨ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਬਨ ਕਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu ihu man udan pa(n)kheroo ban kaa ||2||1||9||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: this mind is like the bird, flying above the forest. ||2||1||9||
